```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

Turns the anonymized raw exports in `data/raw/` (written by `00_anonymize_raw.py`) into the processed files used by
all later steps, and checks each design fact stated in the Method. No respondent and no trial is excluded.

| Manuscript (Method) | Section here | Output |
|---|---|---|
| *Samples*: 51 per sample; 51 of 54 online respondents drawn at random | 2 | `data/processed/sample_flow.csv` |
| *Task and Design*: 12 practice trials, 288 trials (96 per condition), 2,000 ms deadline | 3 | `outputs/tables/task_structure_check.csv` |
| *Data Processing and Analysis*: correct, incorrect, miss; no trimming | 4 | `data/processed/trials_all.csv` |
| *Data Processing and Analysis*: task accuracy, mean correct RT, congruency effects | 5 | `data/processed/respondent_summary.csv` |
| *Conventional Quality Checks*: six criteria | 6 | `data/processed/respondent_qc.csv` |

Sample codes: `Lab`, `Online`, `AEA` (artificial experiment agent). The AGEA sample is processed in `04_agea_data_processing.Rmd`.

# Settings

```{r settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

ROOT     <- file.path("..")                       # paths are relative to analysis/
RAW_DIR  <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "raw")
PROC_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed")
TAB_DIR  <- file.path(ROOT, "outputs", "tables")
walk(c(PROC_DIR, TAB_DIR), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

RAW_FILES <- c(Lab = "raw_lab.csv", Online = "raw_online.csv", AEA = "raw_aea.csv")
SAMPLES    <- c("Lab", "Online", "AEA")
CONDITIONS <- c("congruent", "neutral", "incongruent")

N_PER_SAMPLE  <- 51      # Method, Samples
TRIALS_PER_PP <- 288     # Method, Task and Design
SEED_ONLINE   <- 19      # random draw of 51 of the 54 online respondents

# Method, Conventional Quality Checks
QC <- list(acc_min = 0.80, rt_fast_ms = 300, sd_threshold = 3, miss_max = 0.10, min_keys = 4)

show_table <- function(df, caption) {
  df |> kable(caption = caption, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```

# Samples (Method, *Samples*)

```{r samples}
raw <- map(RAW_FILES, ~ read_csv(file.path(RAW_DIR, .x), show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 100000))
raw$Lab <- raw$Lab |> filter(str_detect(`Task Name`, "Stroop"))   # safeguard; the export holds only the Stroop task

has_trials <- function(d) d |>
  filter(`Response Type` == "response", Display == "Trials") |>
  distinct(`Participant Public ID`) |> pull()

flow <- imap_dfr(raw, ~ tibble(
  sample = .y,
  respondents_in_export = n_distinct(.x$`Participant Public ID`, na.rm = TRUE),
  with_experimental_trials = length(has_trials(.x))))
```

The online export holds 54 respondents. A fixed random draw (seed 19) keeps 51, before any quality check, so that the
three samples are equal in size.

```{r online-draw}
set.seed(SEED_ONLINE)
online_ids <- sample(na.omit(unique(raw$Online$`Participant Public ID`)), size = N_PER_SAMPLE, replace = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(online_ids %in% has_trials(raw$Online)))
raw$Online <- raw$Online |> filter(`Participant Public ID` %in% online_ids)

sample_flow <- flow |>
  mutate(analyzed = N_PER_SAMPLE,
         not_analyzed_no_trials = respondents_in_export - with_experimental_trials,
         not_analyzed_draw = with_experimental_trials - analyzed)
show_table(sample_flow, "Respondents in each raw export and in the analysis")
write_csv(sample_flow, file.path(PROC_DIR, "sample_flow.csv"))
```

# Task structure (Method, *Task and Design*)

```{r task-structure}
structure_check <- imap_dfr(raw, function(d, s) {
  r <- d |> filter(`Response Type` == "response")
  per_pp <- r |> group_by(`Participant Private ID`) |>
    summarise(practice = sum(Display == "Practice"),
              trials   = sum(Display == "Trials"),
              cong     = sum(Display == "Trials" & `Spreadsheet: Congruency` == "congruent"),
              neut     = sum(Display == "Trials" & `Spreadsheet: Congruency` == "neutral"),
              incong   = sum(Display == "Trials" & `Spreadsheet: Congruency` == "incongruent"),
              .groups = "drop")
  pr <- r |> filter(Display == "Practice") |> count(`Participant Private ID`, `Spreadsheet: Congruency`)
  tibble(sample = s, respondents = nrow(per_pp),
         practice_trials = paste(unique(per_pp$practice), collapse = "/"),
         experimental_trials = paste(unique(per_pp$trials), collapse = "/"),
         per_condition = paste(unique(c(per_pp$cong, per_pp$neut, per_pp$incong)), collapse = "/"),
         practice_per_condition = paste(unique(pr$n), collapse = "/"),
         longest_rt_ms = max(as.numeric(r$`Reaction Time`[r$Display == "Trials" & r$Response != "missed"]), na.rm = TRUE),
         misses = sum(r$Display == "Trials" & r$Response == "missed"))
})
show_table(structure_check, "Task structure of the analyzed respondents")
write_csv(structure_check, file.path(TAB_DIR, "task_structure_check.csv"))
stopifnot(all(structure_check$practice_trials == "12"), all(structure_check$experimental_trials == "288"),
          all(structure_check$per_condition == "96"), all(structure_check$practice_per_condition == "4"),
          all(structure_check$longest_rt_ms <= 2000))
```

# Trial data (Method, *Data Processing and Analysis*)

Only response events of the 288 main trials are kept; practice trials, instruction screens and Gorilla's logging rows
are removed. Incorrect responses and misses are kept; no response time trimming.

```{r trials}
tidy_gorilla <- function(raw_df, sample_code) {
  raw_df |>
    filter(`Response Type` == "response") |>
    transmute(sample       = sample_code,
              ex_ID        = as.character(`Participant Public ID`),
              ID           = as.character(`Participant Private ID`),
              trial_number = as.integer(`Trial Number`),
              display      = Display,
              congruency   = `Spreadsheet: Congruency`,
              stimulus     = `Spreadsheet: Stimulus_text`,
              response     = as.character(Response),
              rt           = as.numeric(`Reaction Time`),
              correct      = as.integer(Correct == 1))
}
tidy <- imap(raw, ~ tidy_gorilla(.x, .y))
rm(raw); invisible(gc())

# Order-preserving codes: the i-th smallest original value becomes offset + i. The codes keep the sort order of the IDs,
# so the seeded splits, and therefore every result, do not depend on the coding. The mapping is not saved.
pseudo <- function(x, fmt, offset = 0) {
  u <- sort(unique(x), method = "radix")
  unname(setNames(sprintf(fmt, offset + seq_along(u)), u)[x])
}
stopifnot(n_distinct(nchar(unlist(map(tidy, "ID")))) == 1)   # equal-width IDs: text order = numeric order

NON_TRIAL_DISPLAYS <- c("practice", "break", "instructions", "ready_practice", "ready_trials", "score")

trials_all <- tidy |>
  map(~ filter(.x, !tolower(display) %in% NON_TRIAL_DISPLAYS, !is.na(congruency))) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(sample     = factor(sample, levels = SAMPLES),
         congruency = factor(congruency, levels = CONDITIONS),
         missed     = response == "missed",
         # Gorilla logs a miss on the "Too slow!" screen with Correct = 1; a miss is scored as incorrect.
         correct    = if_else(missed, 0L, correct),
         rt_valid   = correct == 1 & !missed) |>                  # used for response time measures
  mutate(ID = pseudo(ID, "%d", 1000), ex_ID = pseudo(ex_ID, "X%04d")) |>
  arrange(sample, ID, trial_number)

trials_all |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(Respondents = n_distinct(ID), Trials = n(), Misses = sum(missed),
            `Incorrect responses` = sum(correct == 0 & !missed), .groups = "drop") |>
  show_table("Main trials (no exclusions, no trimming)")
stopifnot(all(trials_all$correct[trials_all$missed] == 0))
write_csv(trials_all, file.path(PROC_DIR, "trials_all.csv"))
```

# Respondent summaries (Method, *Data Processing and Analysis*)

Task accuracy is the proportion of correct responses over all 288 trials (a miss counts as incorrect); response time
measures use correct responses only. A congruency effect is undefined if a condition has no correct response.

```{r respondent-summary}
cond_wide <- trials_all |>
  group_by(ID, congruency) |>
  summarise(accuracy = mean(correct),
            mean_rt  = if (any(rt_valid)) mean(rt[rt_valid]) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = congruency, values_from = c(accuracy, mean_rt), names_glue = "{.value}_{congruency}")

respondent_summary <- trials_all |>
  group_by(sample, ID, ex_ID) |>
  summarise(n_trials = n(), accuracy = mean(correct), mean_rt = mean(rt[rt_valid]),
            n_missed = sum(missed), prop_miss = mean(missed), n_keys = n_distinct(response[!missed]),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(cond_wide, by = "ID") |>
  mutate(congruency_effect = mean_rt_incongruent - mean_rt_congruent,   # incongruent - congruent
         facilitation      = mean_rt_neutral     - mean_rt_congruent,   # neutral - congruent
         interference      = mean_rt_incongruent - mean_rt_neutral)     # incongruent - neutral

respondent_summary |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(n = n(), `Task accuracy` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(accuracy), sd(accuracy)),
            `Mean correct RT` = sprintf("%.0f (%.0f)", mean(mean_rt), sd(mean_rt)),
            `Congruency effect` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(congruency_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
                                          sd(congruency_effect, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  show_table("Respondent summaries, M (SD)")
write_csv(respondent_summary, file.path(PROC_DIR, "respondent_summary.csv"))
```

# Quality-check flags (Method, *Conventional Quality Checks*)

| Flag | A respondent is flagged if |
|---|---|
| `flag_accuracy` | task accuracy < .80 |
| `flag_fast_rt` | mean correct RT < 300 ms |
| `flag_rt_3sd` | mean correct RT more than 3 *SD* from the mean of its own sample |
| `flag_no_congruency` | no congruency effect (incongruent ≤ congruent), or either mean undefined |
| `flag_missed` | more than 10% of trials missed |
| `flag_invariant` | fewer than four response keys used |

```{r quality-checks}
respondent_qc <- respondent_summary |>
  select(sample, ID, ex_ID, accuracy, mean_rt, n_missed, prop_miss, n_keys,
         rt_cong = mean_rt_congruent, rt_incong = mean_rt_incongruent, congruency_effect) |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  mutate(rt_sample_mean = mean(mean_rt), rt_sample_sd = sd(mean_rt),
         rt_z = (mean_rt - rt_sample_mean) / rt_sample_sd) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(flag_accuracy  = accuracy  <  QC$acc_min,
         flag_fast_rt   = mean_rt   <  QC$rt_fast_ms,
         flag_rt_3sd    = abs(rt_z) >  QC$sd_threshold,
         flag_no_congruency = is.na(rt_incong) | is.na(rt_cong) | rt_incong <= rt_cong,
         flag_missed    = prop_miss >  QC$miss_max,
         flag_invariant = n_keys    <  QC$min_keys,
         flag_any       = flag_accuracy | flag_fast_rt | flag_rt_3sd | flag_no_congruency | flag_missed | flag_invariant)

respondent_qc |> group_by(sample) |> summarise(across(starts_with("flag_"), sum), .groups = "drop") |>
  show_table("Respondents flagged by each criterion (flagged, not excluded)")
write_csv(respondent_qc, file.path(PROC_DIR, "respondent_qc.csv"))
```

# Integrity checks

```{r integrity}
stopifnot(n_distinct(trials_all$ID) == 3 * N_PER_SAMPLE,
          all(count(trials_all, ID)$n == TRIALS_PER_PP),
          all(count(trials_all, ID, congruency)$n == TRIALS_PER_PP / 3),
          nrow(respondent_summary) == 3 * N_PER_SAMPLE, nrow(respondent_qc) == 3 * N_PER_SAMPLE,
          !any(duplicated(respondent_summary$ID)))
cat("Integrity checks passed: 3 samples x 51 respondents x 288 trials (96 per condition).\n")
sessionInfo()
```
